title: Kissed Sour Middle Eastern Bread Fattoush
description: A comforting Middle Eastern dish featuring toasted bread, mixed greens, and a tangy dressing, made halal-friendly with turkey bacon and shio-cure, in place of parma ham.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Cut the pita bread into small pieces and toast until crispy.
Cook the turkey bacon in a pan until crispy, then chop into small pieces.
In a large bowl, combine the mixed greens, cucumber, tomato, and red onion.
In a small bowl, whisk together the lemon juice and olive oil.
Add the toasted bread, turkey bacon, and feta cheese to the bowl with the mixed greens.
Drizzle the lemon juice and olive oil dressing over the top of the salad.
Sprinkle the sumac over the salad and toss to combine.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
